### A recommended project should meet the following requirements

- [ ] It is not already in the list.
- [ ] It has existed for at least 30 days (counting from the first useful commit, to make sure the library is reasonably stable).
- [ ] It is not entirely AI-generated.
- [ ] It does not depend on libraries other than the standard library (dependencies are not a hard rejection, but please explain them).
- [ ] It has been used or tested, and compiles without problems.
